thread:
Maya: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — I put together a short proposal for expanding our eval surface so we catch the sequence-length KV-cache invalidation we saw. TL;DR: add targeted prompt sets + short chaos load run + a nightly focused regression job.
Sam: awesome, can you paste the minimal test matrix?
Maya: sure, here's the gist — small, focused items we can add to the eval CI: 
```
# eval-matrix snippet
- prompt_set: kv_cache_invalidation
  cases: [prefix_reuse, long_context_switch, truncated_kv]
  metrics: [latency_p95, token_consistency, failure_rate]
- perf_smoke: quick_load_50p50
  qps: [5, 20]
  duration: 3m
  metrics: [throughput, tail_latency]
```
Diego: love the focused set. Can we ensure the prompt_set includes both sampling and deterministic modes? Errors were only reproducible under temperature > 0.
Maya: yes — split by gen_mode in the set. Added that to the doc.
Rachel: suggested owners and timelines? We need someone to own the test implementation + infra plumbing.
Maya: proposal: 
- owner: Diego (implement prompt set & regression harness) — ETA 1 sprint
- owner: Sam (CI job + alerting, add regression to nightly) — ETA 2 weeks
- owner: Infra (add a small dedicated node pool for chaos runs) — ETA 3 weeks
Sam: can take the CI/alerting. I'll sketch the job and the Prometheus alert conditions. Alert ideas: token_consistency delta > 0.5% or p95 latency regression > 20%.
Diego: for the harness I'll add a few deterministic seeds and also a randomized fuzz worker for the chaos drill. Should we run the fuzz worker only in staging?
Maya: yes, run fuzz in staging and a deterministic subset in prod-nightly. Add a guard so the chaos runs don't load the live shared pools.
infra-bot: Note: creating a new node pool requires a support ticket (see ENGOPS-2741). ETA for pool creation: ~5 business days.
Sam: ok — I'll file ENGOPS ticket and link it here.
Maya: other follow-ups: add a short doc section to the postmortem checklist so future incidents include a "test addition" section with owner + ETA.
Rachel: can we ensure test results get surfaced in the console as an eval regression alert? Otherwise people won't notice.
Sam: yep — will add a dashboard row and wire up the alert to the incident channel.
Diego: small implementation detail: for the prompt_set we should include a header that simulates a multi-turn chat, because the cache bug surfaced with alternating system/user tokens.
Maya: good call. I'll update the prompt templates.
Rachel: timeline sanity check: if Diego finishes prompts in 1 sprint and I approve, Sam's CI changes + infra ticket should let the nightly run start within 3 weeks. That matches our SLA for postmortem remediations?
Maya: agreed. If anything slips we escalate to the postmortem owners.
Sam: I'll put the action items in the retro doc and ping the owners.
Diego: I'll open the PR for the prompt_set tomorrow.
Maya: thanks all. tagging @here — let's treat this as prioritized for the sprint. :eyes:
